name: Hawk
otherStatistics: Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A small russet-brown bird of prey with a barred pale breast, hooked beak, and yellow feet with curved talons.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), and printed page 139.
sections.Traits: Keen Sight. Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on sight have advantage.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 1 slashing damage.
sections.At the table: For a passive Perception check based on sight, advantage raises the printed 14 to 19. The Talons attack deals fixed damage.
